in_sanskrit.name: Shersingh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lion King
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shersingh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Shersingh means the king of the lions. It is derived from the words 'shahr' meaning fort and 'singh' meaning lion. This name signifies power, courage, and royalty. It is a name that is often given to boys in Hindu families as it is believed to bring good luck and prosperity.
